# CRONUS language — full LLM reference

> CRONUS is a declarative full-stack language. One `.cronus` file is compiled by the
> `cronus` binary (Rust) into SQLite tables, a REST API, server-rendered HTML, GraphQL,
> cookie sessions and an audit trail. You write `.cronus`, never JS/JSX/HTML/CSS.

Validate every file you write with `cronus build --ai` (JSON: `valid`, `errors[]` with
`code`, `severity`, `message`, `fix`). A file is done only when `valid` is `true`.
Project context for an assistant: `cronus context --for-claude`.

Machine-checked: the blocks between `<!-- begin:x -->` / `<!-- end:x -->` markers are
compared with the kernel source by `cargo test context_grammar` (section types, field
types, aliases, and the example below must build clean).

<!-- begin:grammar -->
## Grammar (canonical forms)

A file is a sequence of top-level blocks. `#` starts a comment. Strings use double quotes.
`key:value` pairs have no spaces around the colon.

### app
```cronus
app "Name" {
  port 5175
  database sqlite "./data.db"
}
```
- `graphql false` unmounts `/graphql` and `/graphql/schema` (404). Default is on.
  Mutations: `create<Entity>`, `update<Entity>(id, input)`, `delete<Entity>`.

### auth
```cronus
auth {
  entity User
  login email + password
  session jwt expires:24h
  roles [admin, user]
}
```
Sessions are HttpOnly cookies (the JWT is not exposed to page JS). Signup is
`POST /api/auth/signup`; passwords need at least 15 characters.

### entity
```cronus
entity Order {
  number    string!  unique match:"^ORD-[0-9]+$"
  customer  -> Customer
  tags      -> Tag[]
  total     money!   min:0 max:10000000
  status    enum [pending, paid, shipped] default:pending
  notes     text     max:2000
  secret    string   sensitive

  transition status {
    pending -> paid
    paid    -> shipped
  }
}
entity Plan shared { name string! }
```
- `name type modifiers`. `!` = required. `-> Entity` = relation (id column).
  `-> Entity[]` = many-to-many (join table): write an array of ids the caller can read,
  read back an id array, `?expand=tags` returns the linked rows.
  Reverse: `Customer` with `Order { customer -> Customer }` expands as `expand:orders`.
- `date` is `YYYY-MM-DD`. `datetime` (`timestamp` alias) is `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` (optional
  seconds/offset). `file` stores an `https://` URL or a `/_files/…` upload (form file
  inputs are sent as data URLs; max 512KiB).
- Modifiers: `!` `unique` `sensitive` `optional` `searchable` `index` `featured`
  `formatted` `default:<v>` `min:<n>` `max:<n>` `match:"<regex>"`. `min`/`max` bound
  numbers, or length in characters for text types. `match` is a Rust regex.
- Invalid writes return `422 {"error":{"code":"VALIDATION_FAILED","message":…,
  "fields":{"title":["must be at least 3 characters"]}}}`; a taken `unique` value is `409`.
- `money` is an integer amount in centavos (2990 = 29.90).
- `shared` after the name: every signed-in user can read all rows (writes stay owner-only).
- The kernel adds `id` (UUIDv7), `_owner_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.

### env
```cronus
env {
  APP_STRIPE_KEY string! sensitive
  APP_FEATURE_X  boolean default:false
}
```
- Types: `string` `number` `boolean` `url` `email`. `cronus run` refuses to start when a
  required variable is missing or a value has the wrong type; values are never printed.
- Prefix every name (`APP_…`).

### import and compose
```cronus
import "entities"
import Pages from "pages.cronus"

compose App {
  use entities
  merge pages
}
```
- `import "file"` and `import Alias from "file"` load that `.cronus` (extension optional)
  relative to the importing file. Nested imports are relative to the importer.
- `compose { use a }` / `compose Name { use a  merge b }` loads `a.cronus` the same way.
  The compose/import nodes are stripped after they have been used as load instructions.
- Several `*.cronus` files in the working directory are unioned the same way (`cronus run`).
- Duplicate entity, page route, `app`, `auth`, `style`, layout, api prefix, component,
  define name, webhook entity or env variable is `COMPOSE_001` (one `app {}`). Missing file is
  `COMPOSE_002`. Last-wins is gone. Each path is loaded once.
- `define Header { section page-header { title "H" } }` then `page "/" { use Header }`
  splices those sections into the page (kit `component` names on `use` stay widgets).

### api
```cronus
api /orders {
  list   GET    /     auth:jwt
  detail GET    /:id  auth:jwt
  create POST   /     auth:jwt
  update PATCH  /:id  auth:jwt
  delete DELETE /:id  auth:role(admin)
}
```
- Methods: `GET` `POST` `PUT` `PATCH` `DELETE` only.
- Auth: `auth:public`, `auth:jwt` (session), `auth:role(a|b)`, `auth:admin`. Anything else
  means a session is required.
- With an `api` block only the declared routes exist (404 otherwise). Without one, auto
  CRUD at `/api/<entity>` requires a session. Non-admins only see and change their own
  rows (`_owner_id`), except `shared` entities (read) and `auth:public` routes (read).

### layout
```cronus
layout Main {
  brand "Acme"
  sidebar {
    "Dashboard" -> "/dashboard" icon:home
    nav "Admin" -> "/admin" icon:settings requires:role(admin)
  }
}
```

### page and section
```cronus
page "/dashboard" type:dashboard requires:auth {
  title "Dashboard"
  section kpi {
    bind Order { aggregate count }
    item "Orders" value:bind icon:cart
  }
  section table {
    bind Order { query all order created_at desc limit 25 }
    columns "number, status, total"
  }
}
```
- Page `type:` `custom` (default) `dashboard` `list` `form` `detail` `checkout` `components`.
  `form`/`detail`/`list` with sections render those sections (not a generic entity table/form).
  `query one` on a table is one row.
- `requires:auth` or `requires:role(admin|editor)`. Matching is by exact route pattern:
  `/admin` does not protect `/admin/users`; declare `requires:` on every protected page.
- Section body: `title "…"`, `subtitle "…"`, `columns "a, b"`, `item "Label" key:value …`,
  `bind …`, `on <event> { … }`. The section type must be one of the lists below.

### bind
```cronus
bind Order { query all }
bind Order { query one where id eq:route.id }
bind Order { query all where status eq:"paid" order created_at desc limit 10 offset 0 }
bind Order { query all where owner_id eq:auth.id }
bind Order { aggregate count }
bind Order { aggregate sum field:total }
bind Order { aggregate sum field:total group_by:created_at interval:month }
bind Order { query all live:true }
bind Product { query all scope:public }
```
- Always `bind Entity { … }` with braces (`bind entity:Order { … }` also parses).
- `query all|one|count`. `aggregate count|sum|avg|min|max` with `field:`.
- `where` operators: `eq` `ne` (`neq`) `gt` `gte` `lt` `lte` `contains` `starts_with`
  `ends_with` `in:[a, b]`. Unknown operators fail the build (`BIND_001`). `in` needs `[ ]`.
  Values: `"text"`, numbers, `true`, `route.id`, `auth.id`, `auth.role`, `auth.email`.
  `query` is `all|one|count` (`BIND_002`).
- `expand:tags` (comma-separated) loads related rows on those fields for SSR.
  Reverse of `Order.customer -> Customer` is `expand:orders` on Customer.
- `interval:` `day` `week` `month` `quarter` `year`.
- Visibility: no session sees nothing unless `scope:public` (every row, to anyone);
  users see own rows and `shared` entities; admins see all. `sensitive` fields never leave.

### actions
```cronus
section form {
  bind Order { query all }
  item "Number" required:true
  on submit {
    create Order
    toast "Saved" success
    navigate "/orders"
  }
}
```
- Verbs the server executes: `set <field> "<value>"` (including `-> X[]` as `"id1,id2"`),
  `create Entity { field "value" }`, `update Entity { field "value" }`, `delete <Entity>`,
  `toast "<msg>" <style>`, `navigate "<path>"`, `refresh <target>`, `open "<name>"`,
  `close "<name>"`. Unknown verbs and `validate` fail the build (`ACTION_001`).
- `create`/`update` on `/_action` use only AST field literals, never client JSON.
- `on click confirm:"Sure?" { … }` asks before running.
- A bound `form` section submits to `/_form`, which writes the row. `create`/`update` in
  `on submit` name the entity (must match `bind`) and do not insert twice; toast/navigate
  from that block are the response effects.

### style
```cronus
style {
  theme dark
  accent "#3b82f6"
  font "Inter"
  radius md
}
```
`theme` is `dark` (default) | `light` | `system` (follows the OS via `prefers-color-scheme`);
`mode` is an alias. Light/system look right with a named `preset` and cronus-ui families;
legacy sections with hard-coded dark colors stay dark.
Other `key value` pairs are kept as config (e.g. `preset aurora`, `runtime voodoo`).

### webhook
```cronus
webhook Order {
  on create -> POST "http://hooks.internal.example/orders"
}
```
Only `http://` URLs are delivered; private/loopback targets are blocked unless
`CRONUS_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE=1`. Payloads are redacted and HMAC-signed.

### component (cronus-ui families)
```cronus
component Email layout:stack style:input { label "Email" }
component Save  layout:inline style:button+primary+md { label "Save" }
```
The first `style` segment is a family name from the family list below.
<!-- end:grammar -->

## Field types

<!-- begin:field-types -->
`string` `text` `email` `url` `file` `slug` `phone` `number` `money` `percentage` `boolean`
`date` `datetime` `ulid` `json` `enum` `ip`
<!-- end:field-types -->

Relations are written `name -> Entity` (or `name -> Entity[]` for many-to-many), not as a
type keyword. An unknown type keyword fails the build (`TYPE_001`), so use only the list above.

## Section types

Built-in renderers (`section <type> { … }`):

<!-- begin:builtin-sections -->
`hero` `features` `pricing` `cta` `faq` `stats` `trusted` `topbar` `checkout` `testimonial`
`footer` `page-header` `stat-cards` `product-grid` `promo` `info-bar` `bento`
`features-split` `team-list` `status-card` `policies` `activity-table` `edge` `sidebar`
`form` `card` `live-keys` `test-keys` `webhooks` `links` `quick-links` `tabs` `accordion`
`breadcrumb` `alert` `chart` `modal` `sheet` `skeleton` `loading` `empty` `error`
`not-found` `404` `kpi` `timeline` `progress` `command` `table` `pagination` `filters`
`dropdown` `toast` `notifications` `kanban` `dark-mode` `layout`
<!-- end:builtin-sections -->

Aliases (rewritten before rendering; prefer the canonical name):

<!-- begin:section-aliases -->
`stats` → kpi, `stat-cards` → kpi, `status-card` → card, `activity-table` → table,
`team-list` → table, `policies` → form, `live-keys` → card, `test-keys` → card,
`webhooks` → card, `quick-links` → links, `promo` → card, `info-bar` → alert,
`edge` → features, `bento` → features, `features-split` → features, `product-grid` → card
<!-- end:section-aliases -->

cronus-ui families (usable as `component X style:<family>`, or as a section type when the
name is not also a built-in above, in which case the built-in renderer wins):

<!-- begin:family-sections -->
`accordion` `alert` `alert-dialog` `animated-button` `animated-checkbox` `animated-list`
`animated-number`
`app-shell` `area-chart` `aspect-ratio` `aurora-background` `autocomplete` `avatar`
`avatar-group` `badge` `banner` `bar-chart` `border-beam` `bouncy-accordion` `breadcrumb`
`button` `button-group` `calendar` `candlestick-chart` `card` `card-stack` `carousel`
`chart` `checkbox` `chip` `choropleth-chart` `click-spark` `code-block` `code-tabs`
`collapsible` `color-picker` `combobox` `command` `comparison-slider` `composed-chart`
`confetti` `confirmation-dialog` `context-menu` `copy-button` `countdown`
`credit-card-input` `currency-input` `data-table` `date-picker` `date-range-picker`
`description-list` `dialog` `dock` `dot-pattern` `drawer` `dropdown-menu` `dynamic-island`
`empty` `expandable-tabs` `fab` `field` `file-dropzone` `flickering-grid` `flip-card`
`floating-label-input` `form` `frame` `funnel-chart` `gauge-chart` `glare-hover`
`glass-card` `gradient-border` `gradient-text` `grid-pattern` `heatmap` `heatmap-chart`
`highlighter` `hover-card` `image-zoom` `input` `input-group` `input-otp` `invite-dialog`
`json-viewer` `kanban` `kbd` `label` `light-rays` `lightbox` `line-chart` `live-line-chart`
`loader` `logo-carousel` `magnetic` `marquee` `masonry` `menubar` `meteors` `metric`
`mode-toggle` `morphing-popover` `multi-select` `navigation-menu` `noise`
`notification-center` `number-flow` `number-input` `orbit` `pagination` `particles` `password-input` `phone-input` `pie-chart`
`pill-nav` `popover` `profit-loss-chart` `progress` `progressive-blur` `radar-chart`
`radio-group` `rating` `resizable` `retro-grid` `reveal` `rich-text-editor` `ring-chart`
`ripple` `sankey-chart` `scatter-chart` `scheduler` `scramble-text` `scroll-area`
`scroll-nav` `scroll-progress` `segmented-control` `select` `separator` `sheet` `shimmer`
`shiny-text` `sidebar` `signature-pad` `skeleton` `slide-up-text` `slider` `sonner` `sparkles-text` `sparkline`
`spinner` `spinning-text` `split-button` `spotlight-card` `star-border` `status-dot`
`stepper` `sunburst-chart` `switch` `table` `table-of-contents` `tabs` `tags-input`
`terminal` `text-effect` `text-shimmer` `textarea` `tilt-card` `time-picker` `timeline`
`toggle` `toggle-group` `toolbar` `tooltip` `tree-view` `typing-text` `usage-meter`
`video-player` `word-rotate` `workspace-switcher` `toast` `motion-presets`
`conversation` `inline-citation` `message` `prompt-input` `reasoning` `sources` `suggestion`
`tool`
<!-- end:family-sections -->

Overlays and pickers open without JavaScript. Menus, popover, hover-card,
notification-center, workspace-switcher, split-button, select, combobox, color-picker,
date-picker and time-picker use native `popover` + `popovertarget` (Esc and an outside
click close them). `dialog`, `alert-dialog`, `confirmation-dialog`, `invite-dialog`, `sheet`
and `drawer` with `trigger:"Label"` or `open:false` use native `<dialog>` +
`command="show-modal"` (focus trap, inert backdrop, Esc). Alert/confirm use
`closedby="closerequest"` (no outside-click dismiss). Without a trigger they render open
(a static specimen). `morphing-popover` and `context-menu` still use `popover`.
`select`/`combobox` options are radios named by `name:"field"` (form value); color-picker
presets are `item "#hex"` lines; a navigation-menu `item "X"` followed by `content:"…"` opens a
panel.

## Complete minimal example

This file passes `cronus build --ai` with zero errors and zero warnings.

<!-- begin:example -->
```cronus
app "Tasks" {
  port 5175
  database sqlite "./data.db"
}

auth {
  entity User
  login email + password
  session jwt expires:24h
  roles [admin, user]
}

style {
  theme dark
  accent "#3b82f6"
}

entity User {
  name     string!
  email    email! unique
  password string! sensitive
  role     enum [admin, user] default:user
}

env {
  APP_SUPPORT_EMAIL email default:support@example.com
}

entity Label shared {
  name     string! max:40
}

entity Task {
  title    string! min:3 max:120
  notes    text    max:2000
  budget   money   min:0 default:0
  status   enum [todo, doing, done] default:todo
  due      date
  labels   -> Label[]

  transition status {
    todo -> doing
    doing -> done
  }
}

api /tasks {
  list   GET    /     auth:jwt
  detail GET    /:id  auth:jwt
  create POST   /     auth:jwt
  update PATCH  /:id  auth:jwt
  delete DELETE /:id  auth:role(admin)
}

layout Main {
  brand "Tasks"
  sidebar {
    "Dashboard" -> "/dashboard" icon:home
  }
}

page "/dashboard" type:dashboard requires:auth {
  section kpi {
    bind Task { aggregate count }
    item "Open tasks" value:bind icon:check
  }
  section table {
    bind Task { query all order created_at desc }
    columns "title, status, due"
  }
  section form {
    bind Task { query all }
    item "Title" required:true
    on submit {
      create Task
      toast "Saved" success
      refresh page
    }
  }
}
```
<!-- end:example -->

<!-- begin:never -->
## Never do

- Never write JS, JSX, HTML or CSS in a `.cronus` file (no `template "<button @click>"`,
  no `fetch`, no helper functions). The kernel emits all markup and client runtime.
- Never store money as a float or decimal string: `money` is integer centavos.
- Never declare `HEAD` or `OPTIONS` routes; the runtime handles them.
- Never leave a data section (`kpi` `table` `chart` `kanban` `timeline` `stats`
  `stat-cards`) without `bind` or items: the build fails.
- Never write `bind Entity` without `{ … }`.
- Never invent field types (`uuid`, `varchar`): unknown types fail the build (`TYPE_001`).
- Never use `indexed`, `computed` or `onupdate:` — the build fails (`FIELD_004`); use `index`.
- Never invent `where` operators — unknown ones fail the build (`BIND_001`). Supported:
  `eq` `ne`/`neq` `gt` `gte` `lt` `lte` `contains` `starts_with` `ends_with` `in:[…]`.
- Never write top-level `service`, `worker`, `middleware`, `deploy`, `test`
  or file-scope `on` — the build fails (`LANG_001`).
- `define Header { section page-header { title "H" } }` + `page "/" { use Header }`
  splices those sections. Duplicate `define` names fail (`COMPOSE_001`).
- Never declare the same entity, page route, `app`, `auth` or `style` twice across
  files (`COMPOSE_001`). A missing `import`/`use` file fails (`COMPOSE_002`).
- Never name an entity or field `select`, `drop`, `insert`, `delete`, `update`, `table` or `from`.
- Never list a `sensitive` field in `columns` or a template.
- Never put `scope:public` on a binding whose rows are not public data.
- Never assume `requires:` on a parent route protects child routes.
- Never keep tokens in localStorage or add a second auth flow: sessions are HttpOnly cookies.
- Never ship an unvalidated file: run `cronus build --ai` and fix every error.
<!-- end:never -->
